content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Consultant (Audit) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://aiimsbibinagar.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-11-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bibinagar (AIIMS Bibinagar), located in Telangana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Consultant (Audit) under recruitment advertisement number AIIMS/BBN/RECT/CONSULTANT/2026/1418.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Bibinagar Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Audit) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Bibinagar Consultant (Audit) jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates need to send their filled application forms via post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of the completed offline application form is 10-11-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Audit) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or Post Graduate Degree in any subject from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years. Please check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. How much is the salary for the Consultant (Audit) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Consultant (Audit) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 60,000.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bibinagar Consultant Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant (Audit) position consists of a screening process followed by an interview.
